info.title: UC Davis IAM API
info.description:
This API provides resources for querying and modifying identity data collected from various sources by the Identity
and Access Management (IAM) team. It is intended for use by developers that need to integrate identity data into their
applications.

get.description:
Returns person records.

This description is shared by `/people` and the people sub-endpoints. Depending on the endpoint path, results may already be pre-scoped by affiliation before the query parameters are applied.

Supports affiliation include and exclude filtering with `affiliationContains` and `affiliationNotContains`.
Supports `affiliationState` filtering with `withAffiliation`, `withoutAffiliation`, or `all`.
The response includes an expanded `provisioning_status` object.

## Filter Groups

Use the query parameters below to filter by different portions of the person record.

### Identity Filters

- `iamid`, `iamids`
- `email`, `loginid`, `mailid`
- `employeeid`, `studentid`
- `pidm`, `mothraid`
- `pps_id`, `cosmos_id`, `cpe_id`
- `health_affiliate_id`, `ucanr_id`, `usda_whnrc_id`, `affiliate_id`, `ucnet_id`
- `manager_iam_id`

### Name Filters

- `firstname`, `lastname` for exact matches
- `firstnamelike`, `lastnamelike` for partial matches

### Affiliation Filters

- `affiliationContains`
- `affiliationNotContains`
- `affiliationState`
- `employmentStatus`

### Student Filters

- `collegecode`
- `majorcode`
- `academic_level`
- `class_level`

`academic_level` also supports grouped values:

- `undergrad`: matches academic levels beginning with `U`
- `graduate`: matches non-`U` academic levels except `ND`

### Organization And Employment Filters

- `department`
- `organizationid`
- `divisionid`
- `subdivisionid`
- `subdivisionl4id`

### Pagination And Change Tracking

- `limit`
- `offset`
- `count`
- `modifiedsince`

- `organizationid`
- `divisionid`
- `subdivisionid`
- `subdivisionl4id`

- `offset`
